description: MetaRalph Phase 6: Collaborative PRD Creation - Conversation threads, proposal discussion, user idea intake, PRD co-creation.

userStories.title: Create conversation model and repository
userStories.description: As a developer, I need conversation tracking so that MetaRalph can have ongoing discussions about projects.
acceptanceCriteria: src/collaboration/conversation.ts exports Conversation, Message interfaces
Conversation: id, projectId, groupId, title, status, createdAt, updatedAt
Message: id, conversationId, role ('user'|'metaralph'|'system'), content, createdAt
ConversationRepository: create(), addMessage(), findByProject(), findActive()
Status: 'active', 'prd_ready', 'closed'
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement Claude-powered discussion engine
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to have intelligent discussions with users about project improvements.
acceptanceCriteria: src/collaboration/discussion.ts exports DiscussionEngine class
Uses Claude API to generate contextual responses
Maintains conversation history for context
Can discuss: proposals, user ideas, implementation details, tradeoffs
Includes project context (README, structure, recent commits) in prompts
Responses are actionable and specific to the project
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement PRD builder with user collaboration
userStories.description: As a user, I need to collaboratively create PRDs with MetaRalph through conversation.
acceptanceCriteria: src/collaboration/prd-builder.ts exports PrdBuilder class
startPrd(conversation, title) initiates PRD creation
Claude helps refine: description, user stories, acceptance criteria
User can accept, modify, or reject suggestions
buildPrd() generates final prd.json structure
Validates PRD has required fields before finalizing
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement idea intake flow
userStories.description: As a user, I want MetaRalph to ask me for ideas and help develop them into PRDs.
acceptanceCriteria: src/collaboration/idea-intake.ts exports IdeaIntake class
promptForIdeas(project) asks: 'What would you like to build?'
Helps user refine vague ideas into concrete features
Asks clarifying questions about scope, priority, constraints
Transitions to PrdBuilder when idea is sufficiently defined
Can handle multiple ideas in one session
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement conversation CLI and dashboard view
userStories.description: As a user, I need to chat with MetaRalph from both CLI and dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: 'metaralph chat <project>' opens interactive chat session
'metaralph conversations' lists active conversations
'metaralph propose <project>' asks MetaRalph to propose improvements
src/cli/components/ConversationView.tsx shows chat in dashboard
Chat supports markdown rendering
Shows typing indicator when MetaRalph is thinking
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Auto-queue PRDs for Ralph execution
userStories.description: As a user, when a PRD is finalized it should automatically queue for execution.
acceptanceCriteria: When conversation.status changes to 'prd_ready', create Task from PRD
Task inherits project context from conversation
Features require approval, quick wins auto-approve
User notified: 'PRD queued for execution'
Task linked to conversation via conversationId
Typecheck passes
